partial_adjudication.basis: Case-by-case reading of task prompt, report ground truth, raw answer and reasoning text, plus grader matched/missed fields; incidental matches do not earn partial credit.
partial_adjudication.review_scope: Original partial grades only; pass, near and original fail entries unchanged.
partial_adjudication.caveat: No full-pass promotions during this partial-only review. Ground-truth questions on population median, missing capital multiplier, VAR/ATR conventions, numerical tests, and intermediate rounding require separate benchmark-wide adjudication.

summary.grading_note: Partial adjudication: incidental matching downgraded; substantive and outcome-correct partials classified separately; existing counts/schema compliance fields preserved.
